---
name: A wrong entry
about: A tool's name, id, category or source is incorrect in the index
title: "wrong entry: "
labels: data
---

**Which tool**
The name as it appears in the index, and its id.

**What is wrong**
- [ ] the name
- [ ] the id
- [ ] the group
- [ ] the source (TTB or All4ONE)
- [ ] the description or controls
- [ ] it should not be in the index at all

**What it should say**
The correct value, and where you saw it — a link to the owning project's catalogue is ideal.

**Which project owns it**
TTB or All4ONE.
